items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: we had a trumpet player in the band in later years by the name of Freddie Webster.

ctx.x: And, you know, we had a trumpet player in the band in later years by the name of Freddie Webster. Oh, that man was atrociously -- atrociously -- just couldn't do right. He overblown. He came to me one time and asked me, hey, Craw, tell me. How in the world can you always be on time? He said, that's going against the grain. I said, well, we were taught to be on time. I was glad he left the band.
So now, you're saying that the things that Lunsford taught you were --
